experiment_data.hypothesis: Turn-residual gating (TRG) improves multi-turn response quality over LoRA-only and base model baselines because it selectively amplifies conversational context signals, which should manifest as higher GAR scores across 4 conditions (base, base+TRG, LoRA, LoRA+TRG).

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/turn_residual_gating && bash scripts/run_4way_eval.sh 2>&1 | tee runs/4way_eval.log"
